pending.body: Reject malformed numeric geometry/depth inputs in the v2->v3 migration instead of silently coercing them. The migration contract explicitly says malformed legacy payloads must fail with `SimError::SchemaMigration` (`crates/tank_core/src/save.rs:30`, `crates/tank_core/src/save.rs:54`), but `migrate_v2_to_v3` currently clamps negative substrate depth with `depth.max(0.0)` (`crates/tank_core/src/save.rs:235`), clamps depth again against `fill_height` (`crates/tank_core/src/save.rs:239`), and falls back to `scale = 0.0` for non-positive/invalid gross volume (`crates/tank_core/src/save.rs:243`). That means malformed schema-2 saves can load successfully and even silently zero dissolved totals instead of failing early. For example, a v2 payload with `geometry.fill_height_cm = -1.0` currently loads as schema 4 with dissolved chemistry zeroed. Tighten these checks to reject invalid geometry/depth values up front, and add a regression test next to the existing malformed-save coverage in `crates/tank_core/tests/save_load.rs:305`.
